<local-command-stdout>## PR Self-Check Result

### Fix
None.

### Note
- [Decidable] The "Where a reformat can change a rule" section's sub-bullet — `"Approaches rejected" accepted any contrast, and "leaves no unexplained hunks" reads as an obligation to give every hunk its own item` — quotes `"Approaches rejected"`, which is the phrase from the (unchanged) Decidable rule about naming rejected design alternatives. The rule that actually changed to fix this problem is in `Necessary` (`Keep out rejected alternatives described at implementation-attempt granularity, and alternatives a reviewer would not arrive at and ask about`), not Decidable's approaches-rejected bullet. A reviewer tracing this explanation back to the diff could momentarily map it to the wrong section before finding the real change in `Necessary`.

### Unverifiable
- [Grounded] The Verification item "Clause mapping built against `git show main:...pr-guidelines.md`, covering the 37 rule bullets the reformat carried over, ... with every clause landing at exactly one destination and none dropped or duplicated" — the count of 37 top-level bullets in the five property sections at the merge base is independently confirmed (`grep -c '^- '` over lines 30-192 of `pr-guidelines.md` at `b9256e4`), but the full clause-by-clause destination trace lives in `ikuwowfiles/pr-guidelines-reformat-check.md`, which is gitignored and not reproducible from a clone, as the PR itself states.

### Property walk
- Decidable: Body follows inverted pyramid (Purpose → Key changes → edge cases → Verification) and its own top-level "Key changes" bullets follow the hierarchy rule the diff introduces, carrying the claim on top and evidence beneath — one cross-reference to a rule name is imprecise (see Note).
- Grounded: Every checked numeric claim held up against independent re-derivation — 17 markdown files, 45 top-level bullets in `pr-guidelines.md` (largest flat list), 37 rule bullets carried over, the property-definition block and PR Body Template block byte-identical to `main`, and no rule-name overlap between the touched properties (grouping/nesting confined to Decidable, distinctness confined to Necessary).
- Necessary: Length is proportional to the number of distinct, individually-verified semantic shifts (4 bounded-prose rules, 2 severity-model changes, 1 parser fix); no paraphrase-of-diff or restated facts found.
- Scoped: All three touched files (`pr-guidelines.md`, `pr-selfcheck/SKILL.md`, `git-workflow/SKILL.md`) sit inside the stated intent — reformatting the rule file plus the two/three-severity model and hard-wrap parser changes that follow from it; a verification mechanism (the clause-mapping and diff checks) is named for the code paths the diff touches.
- Conformant: Title matches the change; no hard-wrap violations detected by the parser (every paragraph is a single raw line); checkbox syntax used only for the Verification section's author-verified items; no auto-close keywords; no URLs appear in the PR body itself requiring a fetch check.

### Verdict
PASS</local-command-stdout>
